title: Everything Claude Code launches all-in-one AI #ClaudeCode #AnthropicHackathon #AIengineering
description: Everything Claude Code introduced a comprehensive GitHub repo featuring 28 specialized sub-agents, 119 skills, 60 slash commands, and more, all designed to transform Claude Code into a fully operational engineering team. Developed during Anthropic's hackathon, the repo includes 1,282 tests with 98% coverage, ensuring reliability and performance. This single repository supports multiple AI models like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini, enabling automated security scanning, memory optimization, continuous learning, and a research-focused development lifecycle. It streamlines complex AI workflows into one accessible package, accelerating deployment and enhancing AI-driven engineering capabilities. The integration of diverse automated hooks, rules, and MCP servers makes this repo a robust tool for developers looking to leverage AI as a full-stack engineering partner in various applications and environments. #EverythingClaudeCode #ClaudeCode #Anthropic #AIEngineering #AIAutomation #OpenSourceAI #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #Codex #GeminiAI #CursorAI #TechInnovation #SoftwareDevelopment #AIResearch #DevOps
